operation.name: notion-delete-pages
operation.description: Move Notion pages to Trash. They can be restored with the restore_pages tool or from Trash in Notion. Database rows are pages. To move a database to Trash, use delete_databases. To remove content inside a page, use update_page instead. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to delete specific pages. Never use it on your own initiative to clean up, deduplicate, or reorganize content. Without user_confirmed: true, nothing is trashed and the error lists what would be moved to Trash; show that list to the user and retry only after they confirm.

proposal: Tu veux que je mette la page [Transformation](https://www.notion.so/2a1b3c4d5e6f47a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6) à la corbeille ?
